events.title: Laufey
events.description: Icelandic-Chinese singer-songwriter Laufey performs her unique blend of jazz-pop and modern standards. Expect an intimate yet grand performance featuring her signature vocals and orchestral arrangements.

events.title: Massive Attack
events.description: Pioneering trip-hop legends Massive Attack bring their atmospheric soundscapes and political, multimedia-driven live show to Brisbane. A landmark experience in electronic and ambient music history.

events.title: Night Feast Live Music
events.description: A curated selection of live musical performances held as part of the Night Feast festival at the Brisbane Powerhouse. These gigs feature a mix of local artists set against the backdrop of an outdoor culinary experience.
